contactPage.title: Send us your report and we'll reply after reading it
contactPage.intro: Tell us in a few sentences what you'd like to dig into (field choice, budget reality check, application timing). We'll pull up your data and write you a real reply, not a template.
contactPage.reportIdHint: We use this to look up your full profile and recommendations.
contactPage.messageLabel: What you'd like to talk about
contactPage.messagePlaceholder: e.g. AU IT master vs CA? Is a RMB 250k budget realistic?
contactPage.successBody: We'll get back to you within 1–2 working days on the channel you picked. No agency push, AI recommendations are not an admission guarantee.
contactPage.errorInvalid: Please check the report ID and message length.
contactPage.errorNotFound: We couldn't find that report. Please return to the original report page and try again.
contactPage.errorServer: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again later.
contactPage.disclaimer: We never push commercial agents in this chat; recommendations are informational only.
